summary: Sheriff of London and Benjamin Franklin's agent; not related (Sayre branch removed).
bio: Descends from Thomas Sayre through Francis, John and John. Died 1818 'at the residence of his son in Brandon, Virginia' (Richmond Enquirer, 10 Dec 1818); son Samuel W. Sayre married Jane Grymes and Virginia Bassett. Francis B. Sayre likewise not kin.
